complaint_types.label: Facility Quick Fix
complaint_types.description: Physical facility issues needing immediate attention — missing equipment, broken amenity, no supplies
examples: No TT ball at the TT court
Broken chair in conference room
AC not working on Floor 4
No tissue paper in restroom
Projector remote missing in Aqua room

complaint_types.label: Behaviour / Misconduct Report
complaint_types.description: Report an individual for unprofessional conduct, harassment, discrimination, or policy violation
examples: A colleague was rude and disrespectful in a team meeting
Someone made an inappropriate comment
Witnessed discriminatory behaviour towards a colleague

complaint_types.label: Inconsistent Staff Behaviour
complaint_types.description: Report inconsistent, unhelpful, or unprofessional conduct by JPMC staff (reception, cafeteria, security, facilities)
examples: Reception staff was unhelpful and dismissive
Cafeteria staff was rude during lunch
Security guard was inconsistent in applying entry rules

complaint_types.label: Food Quality Complaint
complaint_types.description: Report issues with food quality, hygiene, foreign objects, under-cooked items at any JPMC cafeteria or outlet
examples: Food was stale and had a bad smell at Tower A cafeteria
Found a foreign object in the food
Food was served cold despite ordering hot items

complaint_types.label: Workspace / Desk Issue
complaint_types.description: Report issues with assigned workstation, desk allocation, seating, locker, or workspace cleanliness
examples: My assigned desk was occupied by someone else
The floor is too noisy, affecting concentration
Locker is broken and cannot be opened

complaint_types.label: Safety & Security Concern
complaint_types.description: Report safety hazards, security breaches, emergency-related issues, or suspicious activity on JPMC premises
examples: There is a water leak on Floor 3
Noticed a stranger without a badge on the floor
Someone had an accident in the stairwell

complaint_types.label: Recreation Facility Issue
complaint_types.description: Report issues with gym, TT court, sports area, relaxation rooms, or any recreational amenity
examples: The TT table is damaged
Gym equipment is broken
Nap room is always booked and there is no fair queuing system

complaint_types.label: Transport & Cab Complaint
complaint_types.description: Report issues with JPMC office cabs, shuttle services, driver behaviour, or route issues
examples: Driver was rash and drove dangerously
Cab did not arrive at the pickup point
Shuttle was 30 minutes late with no communication

complaint_types.label: HR / Policy Grievance
complaint_types.description: Raise a formal grievance about HR policies, appraisal process, payroll discrepancy, leave denial, or compliance issues
examples: My leave was denied without proper reason
There is a discrepancy in my payroll for this month
The appraisal rating seems unfair given my contributions

complaint_types.label: Cleanliness / Hygiene Complaint
complaint_types.description: Report unclean floors, washrooms, pantry, or common areas that need immediate housekeeping attention
examples: The Floor 4 washroom is very dirty
Pantry area has not been cleaned all day
There is a foul smell in the common area

complaint_types.label: General Corporate Complaint
complaint_types.description: Any other JPMC office-related complaint that does not fit the above categories
